articles.title: Doku 'not against' journalist who criticised him at World Cup
articles.summary: Jeremy Doku says he is "not against" the journalist who criticised his plan to leave the Belgium camp during the World Cup to attend the birth of his first child.

articles.title: Striker snubbed by Scotland for World Cup signs for Sevilla
articles.summary: Sevilla announce £5.5m move, rising to potential £7.6m, for former Scotland youth international striker Robbie Ure to join from Swedish club IK Sirius.

articles.title: Rangers' Chermiti out for 'significant period' with knee injury
articles.summary: Youssef Chermiti faces a long recovery from anterior cruciate ligament damage sustained shortly after Rangers turned down an offer for the striker.

articles.title: Trump warns of 'terrible mistake' if FIFA replaces Infantino
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump has warned FIFA would be making a "terrible mistake" if it got rid of Gianni Infantino as head of world football’s governing body.
